name: yui_aux_0001
statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (z w : YuiEucl (k + 1)), dist z w ^ 2 = dist (YuiHead z) (YuiHead w) ^ 2 + |YuiLast z - YuiLast w| ^ 2
proof:
intro k z w
rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
rfl
